rows.description: A wise avoidant person notices the urge to withdraw, says so aloud and stays a little longer than is comfortable. Small honest disclosures with safe people slowly show that need does not lead to rejection.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: detachment, trust

rows.description: A partner of an avoidant person feels the other goes quiet during conflict and dismisses their needs. Chasing tends to make the person retreat further; calm, direct requests and personal limits are wiser.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
related mind states: calm

rows.description: A toddler moves toward a caregiver then freezes, backs away or looks frightened, since the person who comforts is also a source of fear or is themselves frightened. The child has no consistent way to seek safety.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, confusion, trust

rows.description: A child may bossily manage a parent, act as caregiver or swing between clinging and hitting. This is a survival strategy in unpredictable homes, and calls for safe, consistent adults.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: trust

rows.subtype: Steady adult for a frightened child [Response]
rows.description: A teacher, relative or foster parent offers predictable routines, calm tone and repair after ruptures. The steady presence over months helps the child slowly learn that some adults are safe.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, calm, trust

rows.description: A child suddenly shifts from friendly to explosive or shuts down, and struggles to trust anyone fully. Behind it is a mix of needing and fearing people, and punishment usually deepens it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, trust

rows.description: A teenager craves closeness, then sabotages it, and may swing between intense bonds and cutting people off. Often linked to early fear or loss, and therapeutic help from a trusted professional matters.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, trust

rows.description: A friend sees someone who is warm one week and cold the next. Understanding it as fear rather than a personal insult helps, along with clear boundaries and encouraging them to speak to a trusted adult.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, trust

rows.description: A young adult wants love deeply but feels danger when it comes near, so relationships feel chaotic. Slowly building steady friendships and a reliable helper can start to change the pattern.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
related mind states: affection, anger, fear, nostalgia

rows.description: A partner feels confused by sudden affection then distance, and starts walking on eggshells. Protecting own wellbeing, staying consistent and encouraging professional support matter more than trying to fix the other.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
related mind states: affection, confusion
